# lives. There is no linker script to carve a durable store out of here — the
# image layout is whatever table the second-stage bootloader reads at

column2: so a durable store has to come from a partition declared here and

column2: so the two cannot drift apart — this file is the single

# that flag espflash generates its own default table
# after `factory` and so no home for the store.
# Offsets and sizes must be 4 KiB (0x1000) aligned
# additionally start on a 64 KiB (0x10000) boundary.
